findings.message: counts[p.Name]++ is executed after mu.Unlock() inside the goroutine, so concurrent goroutines write to the counts map without synchronization. This is a data race and can trigger 'concurrent map writes' panics or lost increments, making the duplicate-name check unreliable (e.g. two probes sharing a name may both report n==1 or corrupt state).
findings.suggestion: Move counts[p.Name]++ inside the mu.Lock()/mu.Unlock() critical section (or protect it with its own mutex/atomic) so all map writes are serialized.

findings.message: The names slice is built (with append and capacity allocation) but only its length is used; the loop and make are now dead work. Returning len(c.probes) directly avoids an unnecessary allocation per Describe call.
findings.suggestion: Drop the names slice/loop and return fmt.Sprintf("%d probes registered", len(c.probes)).
